text: **Link for AI v8: the Claude desktop app (artifact_ui.js v8, build_artifact_page.py, patch v13, attached).** Reported on the Mac app: "Open a new Claude chat" did nothing; the desktop app does not open a claude.ai link from inside an Artifact. The card now: (1) a **Copy the text** button (a fresh click, so the clipboard is allowed more often than after an await; if it is still refused, the text opens selected in an in-page dialog for ⌘C), (2) in the app (Electron user agent) the keys for a new chat, ⌘N / Ctrl+N then ⌘V, and no link; in a browser the `claude.ai/new?q=` link stays, (3) the Chrome/Cowork paste line. Card and in-page dialog texts follow `language.talk` (build passes `window.__KIT_TALK__`). Offline test unchanged and green; the app branch is not testable offline.
